name: X-linked Mixed Deafness with Perilymphatic Gusher
aliases: X-linked Mixed Hearing Loss with Perilymphatic Gusher

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for X-linked Mixed Deafness with Perilymphatic Gusher

criteria.description: Presence of mixed sensorineural and conductive hearing loss
Intraoperative or radiological evidence of perilymphatic gusher during stapes surgery or cochlear implantation
Family history consistent with X-linked inheritance pattern
Imaging evidence of cochlear and inner ear malformations such as incomplete partition type III
Identification of pathogenic variants in the POU3F4 gene

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of mixed hearing loss with perilymphatic gusher and radiological cochlear malformation consistent with X-linked inheritance
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for POU3F4 mutations can confirm diagnosis but is not mandatory if clinical and imaging criteria are met.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Mixed sensorineural and conductive hearing loss
searchTerms: hearing loss from nerve and middle ear

pathognomonic.symptomName: Incomplete partition type III cochlear malformation
searchTerms: inner ear malformation with incomplete cochlea

common.notes: Ringing or buzzing in the ears

common.symptomName: Family history of X-linked hearing loss

occasional.symptomName: Facial nerve stimulation during cochlear implantation
searchTerms: facial muscle twitch during ear implant
face nerve activation during cochlear surgery
facial nerve reaction with cochlear implant
hearing loss that comes and goes

rare.symptomName: Sensorineural hearing loss without conductive component
searchTerms: hearing loss from nerve damage only
drooping on one side of face

imaging: High-resolution CT showing incomplete partition type III cochlear malformation
MRI demonstrating abnormal cochlear and labyrinthine anatomy
genetic: Pathogenic variants in POU3F4 gene on X chromosome
other: Intraoperative perilymphatic gusher during stapes surgery or cochlear implantation

distinguishingFeatures: Conductive hearing loss without sensorineural component

redFlags: Profuse perilymphatic gusher during ear surgery
Rapid progression of mixed hearing loss in young males
Family history of X-linked hearing impairment
references: Smeds H, et al. X-linked mixed deafness with perilymphatic gusher: clinical and genetic aspects. Otol Neurotol. 2015.
Zhang Q, et al. POU3F4 mutations cause X-linked deafness with perilymphatic gusher. Hum Mutat. 2017.
